# The Energy Boundary Behind Fusion Ignition

On December 5, 2022, an experiment at the National Ignition Facility at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory achieved fusion ignition. It delivered 2.05 megajoules of energy to the target and generated 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy.

The announcement described the experiment as progress toward inertial fusion energy, while noting that many scientific and technological developments are still needed for practical energy production. The Department of Energy announced the achievement on December 13.
